status: Search cancellation and regular-expression contract for the cross-format command surface.

changes.old: OfficeIMO.Reader.OfficeDocumentReadResultExtensions.Search(OfficeDocumentReadResult document, string query, OfficeDocumentSearchOptions options = null)
changes.new: OfficeIMO.Reader.OfficeDocumentReadResultExtensions.Search(OfficeDocumentReadResult document, string query, OfficeDocumentSearchOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
changes.reason: Search accepts cooperative cancellation for both literal and regular-expression matching. Existing source calls compile unchanged; binary consumers must recompile and method-group bindings must include the token or use a lambda. C# literal matching remains the default.
